== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Therian Nills, also known as Therian, was a member of the [[Stormcallers]]. Originally an ordinary man who had lost everything, he was taken in, trained, and sheltered by the [[Stormcallers]], a group that follows the [[Dreadgod]] to capture its unique [[madra]] and utilize divine techniques to take [[madra]] from others. As a chosen of [[Reigan Shen]], Therian participated in a tournament where he faced [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] of the [[Dawnwing Sect]], who was chosen by [[Northstrider]]. During this match, Therian struggled significantly against [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]]'s hammer, appearing heavily injured throughout the fight. The bout concluded when [[Ziel of the Wasteland|Ziel]] crushed Therian's head, causing his body and blood to dissolve into [[white light]].}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Therian Nills carries a pair of long spears that are covered in a smooth yellow light. He is an ordinary man who comes from a lineage of farmers.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|A former farmer and son of farmers, Therian Nills is a chosen of [[Reigan Shen]] and the [[Stormcallers]]. He has expressed a desire to have joined [[Calan Archer]] if given the opportunity.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=cradle-08-wintersteel|Therian Nills has undergone an [[Underlord transformation]]. He utilizes a pair of long spears that crawl with smooth yellow light as his weapons.}}
